label: Synthetic model-free controlled diagnostics; not live AI quality

dataset.reader: prefers memory, avoids war; counterfactual mood adventure

heldOut.status: not run: no real reading-history input supplied
heldOut.leakagePolicy: Any future history evaluation must partition before profile construction AND discovery. Catalog metadata may be independently retrieved for held-out works, but held-out ratings, reviews and shelves must not influence profile, queries or candidate selection.

limitations: Synthetic labels encode intended behavior; these diagnostics do not estimate enjoyment.
Same supplied pool isolates ranking; no conclusion about live catalog retrieval recall or AI reasoning.
No arbitrary pass threshold: raw counts and batch titles are reported.
Historical exposure/popularity confounds offline ranking; randomized prospective owner feedback is needed.
